claims: Ezekiel 25:17 is focused on divine vengeance against nations that wronged Israel.
Many translations of Ezekiel 25:17 read "And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall lay my vengeance upon them" (KJV).
Ezekiel 25:17 is commonly confused with a fictionalized, violent monologue from the movie Pulp Fiction.
